nodes.label: Bearer access token
nodes.rationale: Short-lived 15 min access token plus 30-day rotating refresh token

nodes.label: Refresh token reuse detection
nodes.rationale: Reuse of a used refresh token signals theft and revokes the device; 60 s idempotent grace window for lost responses

nodes.label: device_revoked error
nodes.rationale: Only this code (with reason user/password_change/recovery/token_reuse/account_deleted) makes the client wipe local data; plain 401 never wipes (safe degradation)

nodes.label: Storage quota
nodes.rationale: Exceeding account quota returns payload_too_large 'storage quota exceeded'; new users get NEW_USER_STORAGE_QUOTA_BYTES (1 GB default)

nodes.label: Client generated UUIDv7 ids
nodes.rationale: Repeated POST with same id and content is idempotent; different content is 409

nodes.label: POST /auth/prelogin
nodes.rationale: Deterministic fake salt for unknown email prevents address enumeration

nodes.label: POST /auth/signup
nodes.rationale: 403 when signup closed (DS_SIGNUP); identical 409 for any conflict; daily limit DS_SIGNUP_DAILY_LIMIT

nodes.label: PATCH /notebooks/:id/mode
nodes.rationale: Enabling agent mode hands notebookKey to server; disabling deletes server wrap

nodes.label: PATCH /docs/:id note move
nodes.rationale: Server changes only the notebook; content, versions, attachments and noteKey stay; client rewraps noteKey first

nodes.label: Author
nodes.rationale: Set by server from who sent the update, never from client claims (D-54); guest shareId is an opaque hash so the link id never leaks

nodes.label: Attachments endpoints
nodes.rationale: Chunked upload with resume; 200 MB default limit; only document owner deletes

nodes.label: POST /fetch-image
nodes.rationale: Image-by-URL proxy (D-52): blocks private networks, no SVG, <=20 MB, 15 s, URLs not logged

nodes.label: Account sharing D-54
nodes.rationale: Notebook or note shared to specific accounts by email with editor/viewer roles; only owner manages access

nodes.label: GET /users/:userId/public-key
nodes.rationale: 404 indistinguishable from nonexistent account so enumeration fails

nodes.label: Invitations endpoints
nodes.rationale: Identical response and timing whether account exists; 30-day lifetime; 50 per day limit

nodes.label: Member
nodes.rationale: accountCreatedAfterInvite: email is not verified, so owner must confirm before key is issued

nodes.label: POST /members/:kind/:id/rotate
nodes.rationale: Atomic key rotation; memberKeys must match exactly active members

nodes.label: pendingSinceVersion
nodes.rationale: Lets any owner device detect where an interrupted key rotation stopped

nodes.label: Shared content belongs to owner
nodes.rationale: Docs created by members count against owner quota and are deleted with owner account

nodes.label: Member agent access
nodes.rationale: Amendment to D-54: member's agent tokens get the member's role on owner's agent-mode notebooks

nodes.label: Account change notifications
nodes.rationale: Owner complained invitations only appeared after restart; server pushes account_changed after commit, polling remains fallback

nodes.label: Voice API
nodes.rationale: Service keys only on server; audio and text pass through memory, not stored or logged (PROPOSED)

nodes.label: Voice quota
nodes.rationale: Per account monthly minutes by UTC; default 600 owner, 120 others; text processing does not consume quota
